place.title: Place {ref} (water level sensor)
place.text: Push {ref}'s 3 pins into column f, one pin per row: − into hole {hole.gnd}, + into {hole.vcc} and S into {hole.sig}. The striped part points up, away from the breadboard.
place.tip: Read the labels printed next to the pins (S, +, −). If yours are in another order, follow the labels, not the picture. Only the striped end may touch water: keep the pins and the parts above the stripes dry.

why: {ref} has bare metal strips: the more of them are under water, the better the water connects them, and the higher the voltage on its S pin.

wire.power: This powers {ref} from 3.3 V, so its S output stays between 0 and 3.3 V, safe for the Pico.
wire.adc: {pin} is an analog input (ADC): it measures {ref}'s S voltage and gives the code a number from 0 to 65535, near 0 when dry and higher the deeper the strips are in water.
